capabilities: Strip tracking parameters from pasted URLs
Fetch page titles and turn bare URLs into Markdown links
Save pasted web images and screenshots into the vault with custom names and sizes
Reindent pasted nested lists and continue block quotes across pasted paragraphs
Clean up terminal output and PDF text with commands and custom regex snippets
disambiguation: Not a document formatter; it works on pasted or selected text only, never on the rest of a note.
extras: The manifest warns the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. README notes no telemetry, GPL v3 license, no pull requests accepted, 21 interface languages, and requests for donations or GitHub sponsorship. Site-specific title fetching uses Reddit, YouTube, TikTok, Loom, Stack Exchange and Dropbox services, which requires network access.
problem: Obsidian pastes content as-is, so URLs carry trackers, Safari image copies turn into links, pasted lists break their nesting, and text from PDFs, terminals and chatbots arrives mangled.
summary: Paste processor that removes tracking from URLs, fetches link titles, saves web images into the vault, and cleans text from AI chats, terminals and PDFs.
